g.text: AI exposure and observed occupational employment growth

g.text: Slope per 0.1 exposure = +3.96 pp (HC3 SE 1.63); R² = 0.085. 162 occupations, baseline-employment weighted.

g.text: Retrospective comparison of observed employment, not projected employment growth. The line is a descriptive WLS fit.

g.text: It differs from the manuscript’s within-high-exposure panel model with occupation/year fixed effects and an exposure-specific trend.
